posts.name: Not every deduction is a distributor problem. Some of the...
posts.text:
Not every deduction is a distributor problem. Some of them started on the truck.

When a remittance comes back short, it's easy to file all of it under the cost of doing business.

But deductions come in two kinds.

Administrative: item setup, promotions, audits.
Freight-caused: late deliveries, missed appointments, pallet problems.

A freight broker can't fix the first kind. The second kind can be prevented before it happens, with a booked appointment, the right paperwork, and a carrier who knows the dock.

Our UNFI and KeHE Compliance Hub breaks down what triggers the freight side and how to prevent it. Link in the first comment.

#CPG #NaturalProducts #UNFI #KeHE #Deductions

posts.name: Your first UNFI or KeHE purchase order has four dates on...
posts.text:
Your first UNFI or KeHE purchase order has four dates on it. Only one is when the truck is expected at the dock.

Ship date. Must arrive by date. Cancel date. Appointment.

New brands treat them as one date. The distributor doesn't.

The MABD is measured at their dock, not yours. The appointment is the slot their scheduling desk gives your carrier. Arrive without one and the truck sits in the yard.

Swipe through the 5 things nobody tells new brands before delivery one.

Every distributor and DC writes its own rules into the routing guide. We'll review yours for free, with no obligation to book freight with us:
https://lnkd.in/ep6JkUkR

#CPG #NaturalProducts #UNFI #KeHE #FoodAndBeverage
